note: Default vital effects (owner, 27 October 2026). A sandbox nicety: a pressor given in any case moves the monitor, whether or not the case authors it. These effects only change the numbers on the monitor. Vitals are never read by a condition, so no phase, tag, flag, prompt, score or debrief line changes. A case action that carries its own vital_effects replaces the whole default, and "vital_effects": [] means no effect. A drip's default lasts until its stop order is given after it, and starts again if the drip is restarted. Onset 20 s for drips and 10 s for boluses. The numbers are teaching defaults chosen by a model and accepted by the owner, not physiology claims, and not physician reviewed.

not_included.dobutamine_drip: An inotrope, not a pressor. It often lowers the pressure, so a default rise would teach the wrong thing.
not_included.epinephrine_intramuscular: The anaphylaxis dose, not a pressor dose.
